title: Event-topology odds: single nuclear recoil versus wall MSSI versus charge-poor electronic recoil versus accidental versus neutron, combining every published handle
question: Combining every quantified topological handle (position, band distance, pulse shape, veto, timing, energy) into a per-hypothesis likelihood table, what are the pairwise odds and the classification posterior over {single NR, wall MSSI, RFR MSSI, charge-poor ER, accidental, neutron, artefact, atm-nu} under LZ's own counts and under the corpus's revised counts, which handle decides each pair, and which unpublished handle would move the odds most?
headline_result: Per unit signal expectation a single NR beats wall MSSI by 10^4.4, RFR MSSI 10^6.9, accidentals 10^4.1, neutrons 10^4.6, atm-nu 10^3.8, charge-poor ER 10^3.6 and an instrumental artefact only 10^2.5; P(NR|event) = 0.994 [0.984,0.998] at s = 1, 0.73 at s = 0.01, break-even s = 4-6e-3; the corpus's background mass sits 85 % in the artefact class and 6 % in ER leakage, both testable only with waveform-level quantities (S1 PSD shifts the odds by +-0.45 dex, artefact audit +-0.2, S2 width/TBA/(x,y) <= 0.08)
key_numbers: LZ neighbourhood bkg 3.5e-4 (WALL 48%, ACC 42%, nu 9%; P070 3.6e-4), corpus 9.4e-4 (ART 64%); (S1c,d) LR 533/372 per signal event (P052 265); log10 odds NR:ART +2.5 [2.0,3.2], NR:ER +3.6 [2.3,4.7], NR:WALL +4.7 [4.2,5.2], NR:RFR +7.8 [7.0,8.6], NR:ACC +3.8, NR:NEU +4.0, NR:nu +3.6; bkg-only posterior (ii) ART 0.85, ER 0.06, nu 0.05, ACC 0.02, WALL 0.01; (i-b) nu 0.55, ACC 0.26, WALL 0.19; P(NR) 0.996/0.966/0.73/0.21 at s=1/0.105/0.01/1e-3; s_1/2 3.7e-3 (MC 6e-3 [2e-3,1.6e-2]); handles: NR-WALL rate/veto/position each x15-20, NR-RFR pulse shape +2.0, NR-ER E x B +6.9, others energy; unpublished: PSD +0.46/-0.44, audit +0.19/-0.21, all +0.49/-0.63, EIG 0.17 nats at s_1/2; variants: ER at 2.8e-3 -> P(NR) 0.982, no ART 0.999, inelastic timing 0.998
model_or_mechanism: marked-Poisson classification posterior P(H|D) = mu_H p_H(D)/sum; handles rate x E(S1c>500) x B(|d|<=2 sigma) x P(position density ratio, P070) x W(LZ pulse statements) x V(1-veto eff) x T(date); class-conditional MSSI position maps (P033) to avoid double counting; 40000-draw log-uniform MC over corpus ranges; binary-outcome expected-information model for unpublished handles
stance: supports DM interpretation (weakly: establishes a single nuclear recoil against every modelled background; residual competitors are unmodelled ER-like classes and atmospheric neutrinos)
result_type: computed (posterior algebra, MC) / estimated (ranges for W, ER tail, artefact prior)
confidence: medium - modelled-background odds survive every variant; NR:ER and NR:ART margins rest on judgemental three-decade ranges
